SourceProxy.name: SHYXResampleLines
SourceProxy.label: SHYX Resample Lines

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Resample Lines: Independent LineMerge, Fuse, and Sample steps on a polyline network.

SourceProxy.Documentation: Three independent steps (all default on). LineMerge pairwise-reduces VTK_LINE / VTK_POLY_LINE cells (merge pairs, then merge those results) so overlapping trunks collapse early. In each pair the left network is kept; vertices of a right polyline that lie on or within Line Merge Tolerance of that network are dropped, and each remaining free run is kept as a branch snapped onto the earlier polyline (a vertex is inserted when the closest point is in a segment interior). Fuse then merges points closer than Fuse Tolerance (default 1e-6 of the longest bounding-box side) so nearly coincident endpoints share a vertex. Sample walks the line graph: vertices whose line degree is not 2 are features and are kept; each branch is resampled at Sample Distance along arc length. If that distance is greater than or equal to the branch length, both endpoints are kept as one segment (short branches are not deleted). Closed loops with no features are resampled around the cycle; a loop shorter than the spacing keeps its original vertices. Each step can run alone; all off passes the input through.

IntVectorProperty.name: LineMerge
IntVectorProperty.label: Line Merge
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Pairwise-reduce polylines (binary tree) and merge vertices that lie on or within Line Merge Tolerance of the left network onto that network. Independent of Fuse and Sample.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: LineMergeTolerance
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Line Merge Tolerance
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Absolute point-to-line distance. 0 (default) uses 1e-4 times the longest side of the input axis-aligned bounding box (matches BoundsDomain scaled_extent). The panel Scale/Reset controls fill that suggestion. Ignored when Line Merge is off.

IntVectorProperty.name: Fuse
IntVectorProperty.label: Fuse
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Merge points closer than Fuse Tolerance so nearby branch ends become one vertex and the network stays connected. Independent of Sample.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: FuseTolerance
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Fuse Tolerance
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Absolute merge distance. 0 (default) uses 1e-6 times the longest side of the input axis-aligned bounding box (matches BoundsDomain scaled_extent). The panel Scale/Reset controls fill that suggestion. Ignored when Fuse is off.

IntVectorProperty.name: Sample
IntVectorProperty.label: Sample
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Resample each branch at Sample Distance, keeping junctions, endpoints, and short branches. Independent of Fuse.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: SampleDistance
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Sample Distance
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Arc-length spacing on each branch. 0 uses 0.01 times the longest bounding-box side (BoundsDomain scaled_extent). If the spacing is >= branch length, only the two endpoints are kept. Ignored when Sample is off.
